app_fee.value: Non-refundable, non-transferable application fee is HK$600 per application for the 2027/28 intake cohort (increased from HK$500 for 2026/27), payable online upon application submission.
app_fee.quote: Intake Cohort | 2026/27 (HK$) | 2027/28 (HK$) | Application Fee | 500 | 600 | The application fee is non-refundable and non-transferrable. You must settle the application fee upon submission of your online application.

fee_waiver.value: PolyU's Research Postgraduate Application Fee page states that the HK$600 application fee is non-refundable and non-transferable and must be settled upon submission for the application to be processed; no fee waiver policy is stated.

gre_general.value: Not required for STEM Research Postgraduate programmes; on PolyU's Supporting Documents for Application page, GRE or GMAT scores are required only by Faculty of Business departments.
gre_general.quote: GMAT or GRE results are required. | Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies | Department of Computing | Academic Referee's Report | Curriculum Vitae | Research Proposal | Transcript / Certificate

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 80 or above in a single attempt taken at a test centre (valid for two years after the test date; no sub-score minimums; PolyU institutional code 0732).
toefl_min.quote: A Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) score of 80 or above for the Internet-based test. | All English language test scores are considered valid for two years after the date of the test. | Remarks: Only tests taken at a test centre and scores in one single attempt are accepted.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic Module overall score is 6.5 in a single attempt taken at a test centre (valid for two years after the test date; no sub-score minimums).
ielts_min.quote: An overall score of at least 6.5 in the International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Academic Module; OR | All English language test scores are considered valid for two years after the date of the test. | Remarks: Only tests taken at a test centre and scores in one single attempt are accepted.

english_waiver.value: Exempt from IELTS/TOEFL if the applicant holds (or will obtain) a degree for which English was the language of instruction at a recognised university, verified by an official transcript or institutional testimonial.
english_waiver.quote: The requirements for those who do not have a degree for which English was the language of instruction at a recognised university are: | An overall score of at least 6.5 in the International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Academic Module; OR

also.quote: Applicants with a degree for which English was the language of instruction at a recognised university are regarded as meeting the English language requirements.

notes: PolyU Graduate School (GS) administers PhD (3-year full-time with research master's/MPhil; 4-year full-time with taught master's or First-Class Honours bachelor's) and MPhil (2-year full-time) programmes across seven faculties and three schools. Effective 1 July 2026, the former Department of Applied Biology and Chemical Technology (ABCT) split into the Department of Chemistry (CHEM) and Department of Life Sciences (LS), and LSGI was retitled the Department of Land Surveying and Geospatial Science (LSGS). For 2027/28 Semester 1 (Sept 2027 Entry), applications open 1 September 2026; most STEM departments close 31 May 2027 (Department of Rehabilitation Sciences closes 30 April 2027; Department of Building Environment and Energy Engineering closes 11 April 2027; HKPFS single-round deadline is 1 December 2026). Full-time PhD funding includes the PolyU Research Postgraduate Scholarship (PRPgS) and International PhD Fellowship Scheme (IPFS) at HK$230,640/yr (rising to HK$235,920/yr after confirmation of registration) plus HK$25,000 conference grant, PolyU Presidential PhD Fellowship Scheme (PPPFS) and Kuok Group Fellowship at HK$340,800/yr + tuition waiver + HK$40,000 Year-1 / HK$20,000/yr cash award + HK$25,000 conference grant, and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) with PolyU top-up at HK$344,400/yr + tuition waiver + HK$14,400/yr conference grant + cash award. 2027/28 full-time tuition is HK$47,000/yr for students with stipend (waived under HKPFS/PPPFS/Kuok/IPFS and UGC local tuition waiver scheme) or HK$99,000/yr without stipend.
